# Aim
Generate and export all manuscript tables in order of appearance.

Note: Tables 1 and 2 are hard-coded in LaTeX and do not require R generation.

Supplementary Table 3 (list of MAVE studies) is compiled manually and not generated here.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(knitr)

date <- "240426"

dir.create("../../Data/Tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

recode_data_name <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_match(x,
    "clinvar_long_uncontaminated" ~ "clinvar_count_weighted",
    "DNM_long_uncontaminated"     ~ "DNM_count_weighted",
    "clinvar_long"                ~ "clinvar_count_weighted",
    "DNM_long"                    ~ "DNM_count_weighted",
    .default = x
  )
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
Clinvar_vs_Biobank <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/Gene_group_models/Clinvar_vs_Biobank_unique_set1_240426.csv.gz")
DNM_vs_Biobank     <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/Gene_group_models/DNM_vs_Biobank_unique_set1_240426.csv.gz")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
altfunc           <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/DDG2P_2025_dominant_selection_genes_AltFunc.csv") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
altfunc_stringent <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/DDG2P_2025_dominant_selection_genes_AltFunc_stringent.csv") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
lof               <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/DDG2P_2025_dominant_selection_genes_LOF.csv") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
other             <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/DDG2P_2025_dominant_selection_genes_other.csv") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
RASopathies       <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/RASopathy_genes_VCEP_030425.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% pull(gene)
altfunc_minus_RAS <- setdiff(altfunc, RASopathies)
macrocephaly      <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/Macrocephaly_monoallelic_DD_somatic_genes.csv") %>% pull(gene)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
AUCs_individual_features <- read_csv(paste0("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_models/AUC_table_gene_groups_single_features_", date, ".csv")) %>%
  mutate(data_name = recode_data_name(data_name))

AUCs_LR_model <- read_csv(paste0("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_models/AUC_table_gene_groups_LR_models_", date, ".csv")) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = paste0(cep, "_LR_model_", test_or_train, "_data"),
         data_name = recode_data_name(data_name))

AUCs <- bind_rows(AUCs_LR_model, AUCs_individual_features) %>%
  dplyr::select(Predictor, data_name, gene_group,
                AUC_full, AUC_full_lower, AUC_full_upper, everything()) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("gene_set"))

n_genes <- read_csv(paste0("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_models/Gene_counts_per_group_", date, ".csv")) %>%
  mutate(data_name = recode_data_name(data_name))
n_vars  <- read_csv(paste0("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_models/Variant_counts_per_group_", date, ".csv")) %>%
  mutate(data_name = recode_data_name(data_name))

performance <- read_csv("../../Data/Tables/Gene_group_single_feature_metrics.csv") %>%
  mutate(data_name = recode_data_name(data_name))
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
gene_AUCs_individual_features <- read_csv("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Single_feature_AUCs_individual_genes_240426.csv") %>%
  mutate(dataset = recode_data_name(dataset))
gene_AUCs_LR_model            <- read_csv("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/AUC_table_gene_holdout_LR_models_240426.csv") %>%
  mutate(dataset = recode_data_name(dataset))
n_vars_per_gene               <- read_csv("../../Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Variant_counts_per_gene_240426.csv")

n_vars_per_gene_clinvar <- n_vars_per_gene %>%
  filter(data_set %in% c("clinvar_mutation_data_unique", "clinvar_mutation_data_long")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = data_set, values_from = c(n_path_variants, n_benign_variants)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n_benign_variants_clinvar_mutation_data_long) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    n_benign            = n_benign_variants_clinvar_mutation_data_unique,
    n_unique_pathogenic = n_path_variants_clinvar_mutation_data_unique,
    n_pathogenic        = n_path_variants_clinvar_mutation_data_long
  )
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
LR <- read_csv("../../Data/LR_calculations/LR_table.csv")
```

```{r}
# Per-gene somatic AUC summary in clinvar_long dataset
genes_clinvar_long_auc <- gene_AUCs_individual_features %>%
  filter(dataset == "clinvar_count_weighted") %>%
  filter(Predictor %in% c("n_COSMIC_codon_count", "n_sperm_codon_count", "n_buccal_codon_count")) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(max_AUC_lower = max(AUC_full_lower, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is.finite(max_AUC_lower)) %>%
  mutate(
    auc_lower_06 = max_AUC_lower > 0.6,
    auc_lower_08 = max_AUC_lower > 0.8
  )

genes_clinvar_long <- genes_clinvar_long_auc$gene
```

# Supplementary Table 1: Full benchmarking results (all gene groups)

Single-feature predictor performance metrics for all gene groups across dataset types.

```{r}
supp_table1 <- performance %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("gene_set")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_group, data_name, everything())

write_csv(supp_table1, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table1.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table1,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 1: Full benchmarking results",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Supplementary Table 2: AUC for each feature for each gene

Single-feature AUC values for individual genes in both clinvar_unique and clinvar_count_weighted
datasets, restricted to the same 705 benchmarking-eligible DD genes (>=10 unique pathogenic and
>=10 unique benign ClinVar variants; Methods) in both dataset forms, so that the two partitions
describe the same gene set and differ only in whether the reported AUC/metrics were computed on
unique or count-weighted variant data.

```{r}
# Same >=10 unique pathogenic / >=10 unique benign eligibility gate used
# elsewhere (e.g. Numbers_for_somatic_germline_paper.Rmd's genes_with_10),
# computed from n_vars_per_gene_clinvar (unique-variant counts only) so it is
# independent of which dataset form (unique vs count-weighted) is being
# reported for a given gene below.
genes_with_10 <- n_vars_per_gene_clinvar %>%
  filter(n_unique_pathogenic >= 10, n_benign >= 10) %>%
  pull(gene)

supp_table2 <- gene_AUCs_individual_features %>%
  filter(dataset %in% c("clinvar_unique", "clinvar_count_weighted"),
         gene %in% genes_with_10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, dataset, everything())

write_csv(supp_table2, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table2.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table2,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 2: Individual gene single-feature AUCs",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Supplementary Table 4: Performance of LR models with DeLong p-values

Gene group-level logistic regression model performance (test set), with DeLong test comparing REVEL-only vs REVEL + somatic data.

```{r}
supp_table4 <- AUCs_LR_model %>%
  filter(test_or_train == "test") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_group, data_name, cep,
                AUC_full, AUC_full_lower, AUC_full_upper,
                AUC_cep_only, AUC_cep_lower, AUC_cep_upper,
                AUC_diff, AUC_diff_lower, AUC_diff_upper,
                delong_p_value)

write_csv(supp_table4, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table4.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table4,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 4: LR model performance with DeLong p-values",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Supplementary Table 6: Gene-heterogeneity model -- functional enrichment results

Odds ratios (Haldane-corrected, single shared BH-FDR domain) for every GO:BP,
GO:MF, PANTHER protein-class, and BioCarta term tested for enrichment between
somatic-data-informative and non-informative genes (source: gene-level
heterogeneity model, `Scripts/Analysis/Gene_heterogeneity_model/Functional_enrichment.Rmd`).

```{r}
gene_het_enrich <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_enrichment_terms_all_sources.csv")

supp_table6 <- gene_het_enrich %>%
  transmute(source, term_id, term_name,
            n_informative_with_term = informative,
            n_informative_without_term = b,
            n_noninformative_with_term = non_informative,
            n_noninformative_without_term = d,
            pct_informative_with_term = pct_info,
            pct_noninformative_with_term = pct_noninfo,
            odds_ratio = OR, or_ci_low = or_lo, or_ci_high = or_hi,
            p_value = p, q_value_BH = q) %>%
  arrange(source, q_value_BH)

write_csv(supp_table6, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table6.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table6,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 6: Gene-heterogeneity model functional enrichment (all terms tested)",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Supplementary Table 7: Gene-heterogeneity model -- per-gene features and predictions

Feature values and model-predicted probability of high somatic-data utility for
all 970 monoallelic DD genes -- not restricted to the benchmarking-eligible
subset, since none of the model's features require ClinVar variant counts to
compute. `training_label` indicates whether the gene was used to fit the model
(`positive`/`negative`, per the COSMIC AUC threshold, restricted to
benchmarking-eligible genes) or was an unlabelled "grey-zone" gene scored by
the fitted model (`grey`; includes genes with too few, or zero, ClinVar
variants to benchmark individually)
(source: `Scripts/Analysis/Gene_heterogeneity_model/Gene_utility_model.Rmd`).

```{r}
gene_het_pred <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_predictions.csv")

supp_table7 <- gene_het_pred %>%
  transmute(gene, training_label = label,
            cosmic_auc = auc, cosmic_auc_lower = auc_lower, cosmic_auc_upper = auc_upper,
            dd_altfunc, dd_lof, cancer_oncogene_missense, cancer_tsg,
            loeuf, moeuf, exp_mis, hotspot_count, net_contrast,
            constraint_missing, network_missing,
            pred_prob_high_utility = pred_prob) %>%
  arrange(desc(pred_prob_high_utility))

write_csv(supp_table7, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table7.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table7,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 7: Gene-heterogeneity model per-gene features and predictions",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Supplementary Table 8: Gene-heterogeneity model -- feature dictionary and importance

Definition and data source for each model feature, alongside its random-forest
SHAP importance and ridge-logistic-regression odds ratio (source: `Gene_utility_model.Rmd`).

```{r}
gene_het_shap <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_shap_summary.csv")
gene_het_or   <- read_csv("../../Data/ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_ridge_or.csv")

feature_dict <- tribble(
  ~feature,                    ~description,                                                                                          ~data_source,
  "dd_altfunc",                 "Gene has a monoallelic DDG2P disease association with an altered-function mechanism (variant_consequence includes altered gene product structure)", "DDG2P",
  "dd_lof",                     "Gene has a monoallelic DDG2P disease association with a loss-of-function mechanism (variant_consequence includes absent or decreased gene product)", "DDG2P",
  "cancer_oncogene_missense",   "COSMIC Cancer Gene Census annotates the gene as an oncogene with missense driver mutations",                                                       "COSMIC Cancer Gene Census v98",
  "cancer_tsg",                 "COSMIC Cancer Gene Census annotates the gene as a tumour suppressor gene",                                                                          "COSMIC Cancer Gene Census v98",
  "loeuf",                      "gnomAD loss-of-function observed/expected upper bound fraction (constraint against LOF variation)",                                                "gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics",
  "moeuf",                      "gnomAD missense observed/expected ratio (constraint against missense variation)",                                                                  "gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics",
  "exp_mis",                    "gnomAD expected missense variant count (proxy for mutability and coding sequence length)",                                                         "gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics",
  "hotspot_count",               "Number of recurrent somatic mutation hotspot residues listed for the gene (raw count, not length-normalised)",                                    "cancerhotspots.org v2",
  "net_contrast",               "log10 ratio of random-walk-with-restart proximity (STRING PPI) to the positive-labelled gene network vs. the negative-labelled gene network; leave-one-out for labelled genes", "STRING v12 PPI"
)

supp_table8 <- feature_dict %>%
  left_join(gene_het_shap, by = "feature") %>%
  left_join(gene_het_or %>% rename(feature = term, ridge_or = estimate,
                                    ridge_or_ci_low = conf.low, ridge_or_ci_high = conf.high),
            by = "feature") %>%
  transmute(feature, description, data_source,
            mean_abs_shap = mean_abs, shap_direction_corr = direction_corr,
            ridge_or, ridge_or_ci_low, ridge_or_ci_high) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap))

write_csv(supp_table8, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table8.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table8,
              caption = "Supplementary Table 8: Gene-heterogeneity model feature dictionary and importance",
              filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r}
supp_table9 <- LR %>%
  filter(data_set %in% c("clinvar_long_public", "clinvar_unique_public",

  arrange(data_set, gene_group, feature)

write_csv(supp_table9, "../../Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table9.csv")

DT::datatable(supp_table9,
```
